implementation_state: The typed contract exists as five validated types plus one error enum in ml/decision_contract.rs: ModelInput rejects malformed and wrong-dimension snapshots, DecisionState admits exactly one legal successor per phase and refuses a transition that contradicts the input, DecisionCandidate keeps planned/attempted/served as three separate facts, and DecisionDistribution validates arity, uniqueness, finiteness, and normalization. It sits beside the accepted engine rather than replacing it. Accepted on dev at 79304a4.
unblock_condition: Accepted: every required type exists, is validated, and is provable from the retained production input.
notes: The audit decision was BLOCKED for want of a trustworthy production input; that reason is closed and this node's contract work is accepted.

The contract deliberately sits beside DecisionEngine rather than wrapping or replacing it: the engine is an exact reproduction of frozen Coordinator::decide semantics, so a wrapper would create a second decision path free to diverge. ml/decision_engine.rs and ml/model.rs are byte-for-byte unchanged.
No contract type derives Deserialize, so a decision contract cannot be reconstructed from unvalidated bytes; validation happens where ModelInput is built from the retained snapshot.
DecisionModel exposes no update, reset, train, fit, or &mut self method, so the training surface is unreachable through this API. A later node must add a seam deliberately.
DecisionDistribution is the type only. Calibrated K-way distributions belong to 7E-2D.
Accepted as c253805 on node/7e-2a-contract, integrated as 79304a4; review and gates are E-070 through E-072.
